headlines.title: Boeing SPEEA engineers ratify contract, averting strike
headlines.summary: The deal averts a potential strike that could have disrupted certification of the 737 Max 10 and 777X

headlines.title: Boeing (BA) Wins Navy F A XX Fighter Program In Fresh Defense Vote
headlines.summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) has been awarded the U.S. Navy's F/A-XX sixth-generation fighter contract, a multi billion dollar program. The F/A-XX is planned to replace the Navy's current F/A-18 Super Hornet fleet and extend carrier air wing reach. This award follows Boeing's earlier win on the U.S. Air Force's F-47 next generation fighter, consolidating its role in future combat aircraft.

headlines.title: Boeing Workers Avert Strike Threat With New Four-Year Deal — BA Stock Jumps 3%
headlines.summary: The four-year deal removes a near-term labor threat as Boeing ramps up jet production and works to secure delayed 737 MAX 10 and 777X certifications.

headlines.title: Nearly 10K Boeing workers ratify contract, avoiding West Coast strike
headlines.summary: The union contract between SPEEA-represented employees at the company’s facilites across Washington, Oregon, Utah and California was set to expire Oct. 6.

headlines.title: Boeing Offered 17,000 Workers a 32% Raise. A Retired Engineer’s Union Strike Check Can Count as $0 Toward Social Security’s Earnings Test
headlines.summary: A Boeing engineer on strike can collect tens of thousands in union payments and watch the Social Security earnings test treat nearly every dollar as though it never existed, yet the IRS tells a completely different story come tax season.

description: The Boeing Company, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, sells, services, and supports commercial jetliners, military aircraft, satellites, missile defense, human space flight and launch systems, and services worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Commercial Airplanes; Defense, Space & Security; and Global Services. The Commercial Airplanes segment develops, produces, and markets commercial jet aircraft for passenger and cargo requirements. The Defense, Space & Security segment engages in the research, development, production, and modification of manned and unmanned military aircraft and weapons systems; strategic defense and intelligence systems, which include strategic missile and defense systems, command, control, communications, computers, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, cyber and information solutions, and intelligence systems; and satellite systems, such as government and commercial satellites, and space exploration. The Global Services segment offers products and services, including supply chain and logistics management, engineering, maintenance and modifications, upgrades and conversions, spare parts, pilot and maintenance training systems and services, technical and maintenance documents, and data analytics and digital services to commercial and defense customers. The Boeing Company was incorporated in 1916 and is based in Arlington, Virginia.
